history.created_by: sh -c apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 dbus gnome-keyring libglib2.0-bin ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN /bin/sh -c if ! command -v gnome-keyring-daemon >/dev/null; then       apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 dbus gnome-keyring libglib2.0-bin ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*;     fi &&     (getent passwd 1000 >/dev/null || useradd --uid 1000 --create-home messenger) &&     mkdir -p /app /data /run/messenger && chown 1000:1000 /data /run/messenger # buildkit
COPY engine.py server.py web.py messenger_addresses.py API-contract.json /app/ # buildkit

ENV MESSENGER_DATA=/data MESSENGER_PORT=8765 XDG_DATA_HOME=/data XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/messenger WN_SECRET_STORE=keychain WN_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE=org.wizardos.messenger.marmot.v1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

HEALTHCHECK {Test:[CMD-SHELL python3 -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8765/healthz', timeout=3)"] Interval:30s Timeout:5s StartPeriod:10s StartInterval:0s Retries:3}
